# Pacific Science Center

> > Seattle's premier science museum and STEM education center, featuring IMAX theater, Laser Dome, Tropical Butterfly House, and hands-on exhibits since the 1962 World's Fair.

Pacific Science Center (PacSci) is a nonprofit science museum located at Seattle Center in Washington, designed by Minoru Yamasaki for the 1962 World's Fair. The center provides interactive exhibits, educational programming, and community outreach including Science on Wheels and accessibility initiatives like Sensory-Friendly Hours.

- Pacific Science Center (PacSci)

## About & Visitor Information

- [About PacSci](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/about): Mission, values & history of Seattle's science museum since 1962 World's Fair
- [History of PacSci](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/about/pacsci-history): Minoru Yamasaki-designed Seattle landmark history from 1962 World's Fair
- [IMAX](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/visit/imax): PACCAR IMAX Theater tickets, pricing, films & accessibility in Seattle
- [Sensory-Friendly Hours](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/events/sensory-hours): Autism-friendly reduced-stimulation hours with Sensory Lounge access

## Events & Experiences

- [Live at the Laser Dome: KEXP DJ in Residence](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/events/pacsci-kexp-laser): KEXP DJ Diana Ratsamee performs Eastern Echoes live at Laser Dome
- [Blue Whales: Return of the Giants](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/shows/blue-whales-imax): Andy Serkis-narrated IMAX documentary on blue whales in Seychelles Islands
- [PacSci Reopens its Doors to the Public Today](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/press/pacsci-reopens): PacSci reopening announcement featuring Tropical Butterfly House & Planetarium

## Educational Resources & Activities (English)

- [Live Science Show: Super Cold](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/live-science-show-super-cold): K-8 physics demo video featuring liquid nitrogen cryogenics experiments
- [Paint Me Pollinated](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/paint-me-pollinated): K-8 hands-on biology activity about plant pollination and reproduction
- [Bubble Blast](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/bubble-blast): Elementary chemistry activity exploring bubble properties hands-on
- [Creating an Afterimage](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/creating-afterimage): Vision science activity exploring optical illusions and sensory perception
- [Pattern Hunt](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/pattern-hunt): K-8 outdoor math activity with downloadable worksheets on nature patterns
- [Coloring Sheet: Dinosaur Fossils](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/coloring-page-dinosaur-fossils): Downloadable dinosaur fossils coloring sheet for early childhood learning

## Spanish-Language Resources

- [Constelaciones de Malvavisco](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/constelaciones-malvavisco): Spanish astronomy activity building 3D marshmallow constellation models
- [Veleta Casera](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/veleta-casera): Spanish DIY weather vane activity for K-8 earth science learning
- [Creadores de Cráteres](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/resources/creadores-de-crateres): Spanish K-8 activity on moon craters, asteroids & meteorite impacts

## News & Community

- [Do-It-Yourself Engineering Challenges](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/blog/diy-engineering): Boeing-sponsored DIY engineering activities for National Engineers Week
- [PacSci's Beloved Dinosaurs Are Looking for New Homes](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/blog/dinosaur-adoption): PacSci fundraises by offering animatronic dinosaurs for adoption
- [PacSci Real Estate Transaction](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/press/pacsci-real-estate-transaction): PacSci property sale to Space Needle LLC for facility improvements
- [The A to Z of Free or Low-Cost Family Activities Around Seattle](https://pacificsciencecenter.org/blog/family-activities-around-seattle): A-Z guide to free and low-cost family activities around Seattle area
